Rich, Indulgent, but Not Quite Flawless
Aug 2026 • Solo
Amuse-Bouche — The amuse-bouche was nice and savory overall. I just didn’t particularly like the pastry component since I found it a little too plain compared with the other two bites, which were much more flavorful.

A5 Japanese Beef Carpaccio — The beef was buttery, rich, and sliced thinly enough for a carpaccio. The burrata was creamy, the vegetables were fresh, and the caviar added a nice touch of salinity to the dish. My only issue was the presentation: I wish the beef had been more visible, as it was almost completely hidden underneath the other components. 

Smoky A5 Beef Ribeye — I asked for the steak medium-rare, but some parts were closer to rare. More importantly, I didn’t think the steak was smoky enough for a dish specifically called “Smoky A5 Beef Ribeye.” The three accompanying sauces were all good and paired well with the steak, while the vegetables provided a nice contrast with their crunch and freshness.

The service was excellent. The server was really nice.
